name: AK28AH - Desktop Indoor Air Quality Monitor (CO2, TVOC, HCHO, PM1.0, PM2.5, PM10, Temperature, Humidity), NDIR & Electrochemical Sensors, 4-Button Control
highlights: The AK28A With Its Two Gas Channels Upgraded — Four front keys and the wedge stand stay; the CO₂ and formaldehyde channels move to infrared NDIR and an electrochemical cell. Hardware controls with hardware-grade sensing.

For Sites Where Someone Actually Operates It — A monitor that gets set, muted, dimmed and re-set by different people benefits from dedicated keys. One that also gets quoted in a report benefits from these sensors.
Laser Particulate Split — Three particulate fractions separated rather than averaged into one number.
2500 mAh, Six Hours — Four-hour USB-C charge, 246 g.
32 Per Carton — Same packing as the standard AK28.
